topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 389 project-authored contract(s) across 10 chain(s); 167 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs, 3 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 80 common project-authored base contract(s) (pendlebasetoken, pendleerc20permitupg, pendleerc20upg). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
